There are 2 steps being taken to help ensure reliable up time and performance in the near future.

My aim is to receive almost immediate notifications if one our application services is not running properly / at all. This is something that all online services should have in place and we are now in a good position to allot the required resources to accomplish it.

2) We are discussing and looking into options to add more servers in order help spread out the load and improve up time and performance. This will take a little time to figure out as the main considerations are cost and host reliability. We are able to throw more servers at a traffic problem with our current host, it is just a bit costly. While all of your pictures are safely stored off site and the domain is separated from the host, we are obviously very cautious about changing hosts because of the previous fiasco.
